text:
nadia-finance: Quick note for teams working with non-US vendors  we've added new onboarding requirements for international suppliers (tax forms, local payment options). Please read: https://redwood.company/finance/international-onboarding :world_map:

procurement-bot: POLICY UPDATE by @nadia-finance
- Non-US vendors require a local tax ID or W-8 equivalent before payment.
- For vendors in EUR/GBP zones, finance prefers invoice + bank transfer (SEPA/UK Faster Payments). Virtual cards allowed only when vendor portal requires card.
- For vendors in APAC, supply local tax registration and remittance instructions.

ken-engineering: quick Q  we just closed a contract with an analytics vendor in Germany for 8 3,200 (approx $3.5k). Do we need a PO?

nadia-finance: if amount < $5k treat per delegated approvals (team approval ok) but still need vendor tax docs and banking details. Start `/procure onboard` and attach their VAT ID + invoice.

irina-legal: heads-up  any master services agreement involving data processing must include our DPAs regardless of amount. Legal will review within 3 business days if DPAs present.

ken-engineering: thanks. The vendor asked for our W9. They are asking for a US tax form to avoid withholding. Are we required to provide one?

procurement-bot: Reminder: only provide W9 to US vendors requesting it. Non-US vendors should supply W-8BEN or W-8BEN-E to claim treaty benefits. Contact payroll if withholding questions.

tom-ops: For payment timelines  SEPA transfers take ~2 business days. Any guidance on invoice currency and FX handling?

nadia-finance: prefer invoices in vendor local currency; finance will translate and post GL in USD. If currency risk is material (> $25k), flag FP&A for hedging guidance. Small invoices we absorb FX.

irina-legal: Also: confirm vendor is not on restricted parties list. Procurement bot will block onboarding if a match is found. If blocked, ping legal and security immediately.

ken-engineering: filing `/procure onboard` now. Attaching VAT, invoice, contact. Should I include PO description like US vendors?

nadia-finance: yes please  simple PO snippet is fine: project, vendor legal name, amount (local+USD estimate), business justification, billing contact, and tax ID. Example: 
```
Project: Data Platform
Vendor: Analytica GmbH
Amount: 8 3,200 (~$3,500)
Justification: EU analytics retention for telemetry
Billing contact: finance@analytica.de
Tax ID: DE123456789
```

procurement-bot: New onboarding commands: `/procure onboard` + `--currency` flag and `/procure tax-check` to validate tax docs.

tom-ops: thanks  ops will add a note about payment method to vendor onboarding playbook.

nadia-finance: final note  expect onboarding turnaround ~23 business days for standard EU vendors once docs are complete. For APAC, might be longer due to local regs. If urgent, mark `exec-exception` with reason and attach approval.

ken-engineering: perfect, thanks everyone.
